fact: Until 2022 the collectivités territoriales executed their budgets in the off-line system El Khazin; from 2022 they began using SIGeL for revenue and expenditure operations, accounting and reporting, deployed in 90% of collectivités territoriales at end 2023 (232 existed at end 2022), giving the DFL and DGCT standardised, real-time access to the data of communes and regions; the text does not say how the commune offices are connected.
title: Évaluation de la performance de la gestion des finances publiques de la Mauritanie selon la méthodologie PEFA 2016 — Rapport final (Version définitive - Janvier 2025)
